memory_annotations.evidence_summary: Marcus endorsed having business class surfaced first when feasible, then declined it for this change because the $1,086 premium was not workable and accepted economy as the fallback.

messages.content: The airline moved our Monday flight home. Compare leaving it alone with taking the earlier flight, including what we do with the bags after checkout.

Your PIT-ORD return under P6T8RM now departs at 7:42 p.m. and arrives at 8:25 p.m., nearly three hours later than booked. The same-airport alternative leaves PIT at 2:20 p.m. and arrives at 3:03 p.m. Business class is available for an additional $1,086 total; standard economy adds $174 total for all three. Schenley House confirms it will hold your luggage free after the 11:00 a.m. checkout.
Business should be the first option when it’s feasible, but that increase isn’t. Coach is fine for this change. Can the three of us sit together on the 2:20?

Not currently. The 2:20 has three economy seats, but they are split: 18A, 19D, and 21C. The airline cannot guarantee reseating at the gate. Your delayed 7:42 flight still has three adjacent seats available in row 24 for assignment at no charge.
What about the earlier flight from the other airport? I saw one around 3:00.

The 3:05 p.m. departure is from Latrobe, about 55-75 minutes from the hotel versus roughly 25-35 minutes to PIT. A new ride would be about $105-$135, and its three available economy seats are also in separate rows. The fare difference is $96 total, so it would cost roughly $201-$231 more once transportation is included.
Then compare the actual Monday timing for the 2:20 at PIT and the delayed flight.

For the 2:20, retrieve the bags around 11:45 a.m., leave the hotel near noon, and reach PIT about 12:25-12:35 for a comfortable check-in window. You would be home by roughly 4:00 p.m. For the 7:42, the hotel can hold the bags while you spend the afternoon nearby; collect them around 4:45, leave by 5:00, and reach PIT around 5:30. You would be home around 9:20 p.m. The earlier option buys about five hours at home for $174 but separates all three of you.
That doesn’t improve the day enough. Keep the later flight, assign row 24, and note that the hotel will hold the luggage. Is there any credit or new charge?

The 7:42 p.m. PIT-ORD return remains confirmed under P6T8RM, and seats 24A, 24B, and 24C are now assigned for Marcus, Daniel, and Owen at no charge. Schenley House has confirmed complimentary luggage storage after Monday’s 11:00 a.m. checkout. There is no fare credit for accepting the schedule change and no additional payment. The hotel, outbound flight, and total charged amount of $1,793.46 are unchanged; rides remain unbooked and unpaid.
